name: §4Realm of Death
description: Aim at a hostile mob or another player within 40 blocks. After a short windup, you and that target are trapped in a separate arena for up to 60 seconds. The cooldown begins only after a target is successfully pulled into the realm. You gain +20% Spell Power, attack damage, armor, and maximum health, plus +15% attack speed. The enemy has Weakness I. Cooldown: 4 minutes.
